# Paddltir

> Dragon boat crew management for coaches, sweeps, and club organisers.
> Build rosters, seat boats heat by heat, and check trim and side balance
> before you push off. Web app at https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/app —
> sign in with email or Google on first visit.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): product copy and main pages as a single markdown file
- [Get started](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/install): open the app and sign in
- [Guides](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/guides): reference guides — how to seat a standard boat (/guides/ai-agent-tax-deductions) and how to run multiple heats (/guides/can-ai-do-my-bas)
- [Blog](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/blog): race-day stories — seating a crew (/blog/what-can-you-actually-claim), regatta prep (/blog/its-bas-time-again), weight and trim (/blog/so-you-bought-a-laptop-in-the-eofy-sales), lineup balance (/blog/am-i-going-to-get-audited), spreadsheets vs a crew tool (/blog/can-you-trust-ai-with-your-tax), and heat records (/blog/nobody-withholds-your-tax-anymore)
- [FAQ](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/faq): rosters, crewlists, trim, privacy, and getting started
- [Compare](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/compare): paper roster vs spreadsheet vs Paddltir
- [GitHub](https://github.com/junlee-3/paddltir-web): marketing site source

## App

- Web app: https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/app
- Sign in with email or Google — account created on first visit
- Works in any modern browser on desktop or mobile

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://paddltir-web.vercel.app/privacy): what we store about your account and crew data
